title: The DB Tools rely on the TLS implementation in Golang’s standard library, which generally uses the… (CVE-2026-116641)
description: DB Tools versions compiled with Golang 1.26.8 rely on a TLS implementation that does not include an internal denylist for certain known-bad CA certificates, specifically the eMudhra certificates. This issue is addressed in Golang 1.27.3, which adds these certificates to the denylist. DB Tools version 100.20.0 updates to Golang 1.27.3 to resolve this vulnerability.
